name: Question 3
problem:
A series RC circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of $16\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)\,\text{V},$ a resistance of $80\,Ω,$ and a capacitance of $0.00125\,\text{F}.$ Find the differential equation governing the amount of charge $q$ (in coulombs) on the capacitor at time $t$ (in seconds).

*Hint: The voltage drop ${V}_{C}$ across the capacitor is related to its charge by $q=C{V}_{C},$ where $C$ is the capacitance measured in Farads.*

Question 3
?

A series RC circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of 16cos⁡(3t)V, a resistance of 80Ω, and a capacitance of 0.00125F. Find the differential equation governing the amount of charge q (in coulombs) on the capacitor at time t (in seconds).

Hint: The voltage drop VC across the capacitor is related to its charge by q=CVC, where C is the capacitance measured in Farads.

a
dqdt+800q=15cos⁡(3t)
b
dqdt+80q=116cos⁡(3t)
c
dqdt+10q=15cos⁡(3t)
d
dqdt+10q=16cos⁡(3t)
e
dqdt+800q=16cos⁡(3t)
